name: Finish the Year
summary: A six-week sprint from late November to December 31 to finish one goal you started this year, with weekly benchmarks and someone in your corner.

onboarding.prompt: Which goal are you carrying over the line?
onboarding.reaction: That one. Let's make it real.
Got it. We'll use the matching guardrails.

onboarding.prompt: What does done look like by Dec 31?
onboarding.reaction: Clear finish lines are easier to cross.

onboarding.prompt: How many hours a week can you give it?
onboarding.reaction: We'll only plan the time you give us.

onboarding.prompt: Tap the times you'll work on it.

phases.name: Take stock
benchmarks: Finish line written and the remaining work listed
actions: Cut anything that won't fit by Dec 31

phases.name: Sprint
benchmarks: Half of the remaining work done by the end of week 4
actions: Friday check-in with your partner or circle

phases.name: Holiday-proof stretch
benchmarks: A holiday-week plan that keeps at least two short sessions
actions: Short sessions around travel and family time

phases.name: Finish line
benchmarks: Goal marked finished or a clear carry-over plan for January
actions: Share your finish card if you want to

plan_blueprint.calendar: Work sessions at your chosen slots, a Friday check-in each week, and a Dec 31 finish-line event.

approach_variants.habit: A small daily session at the same time, streak tracked through the holidays.
approach_variants.willpower: A countdown to Dec 31 with a weekly challenge from your partner.
approach_variants.time: Every session is a calendar block; Sunday review of planned vs actual time.
approach_variants.reward: A reward you pick for each weekly benchmark and a bigger one at the finish.
approach_variants.resource: Week 1 gathers what you need (tools, help, money) before the sprint starts.

guardrails: Plans are suggestions. You choose every step and can change or remove any of them.
Health goals add a 'talk to your doctor' step; money goals carry a not-financial-advice notice. GoalKin offers education, not medical or financial advice.
restart_rules: Miss a session: do a 15-minute version the next day. Miss a week: the plan shrinks to the single most important piece and the finish line can move to a January carry-over plan.

price_log.basis: Launch program price per docs/PRD.md and docs/DECISIONS.md #8; pending owner approval
